scene.ko: 기차에서 여권을 도난당해 경찰서에 신고하고, 대사관에서 할 일까지 차근차근 묻는다.

lines.en: Hello. I'd like to report a lost passport. I think it was stolen on the train this morning.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 여권 분실 신고를 하고 싶어요. 오늘 아침 기차에서 도난당한 것 같아요.
alt: Hi. I need to report my passport missing. I think someone stole it on the train this morning.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me exactly what happened?
lines.ko: 그러셨군요. 무슨 일이 있었는지 정확히 말씀해 주시겠어요?

lines.en: My bag was on the rack above my seat. When I got off, the front pocket was open and my passport was gone.
lines.ko: 가방을 제 자리 위 선반에 뒀는데요. 내릴 때 보니 앞주머니가 열려 있고 여권이 없었어요.
alt: I put my bag on the shelf above my seat. When I got off the train, the front pocket was open and my passport wasn't there.

lines.en: Did you lose anything else, like cash or cards?
Just some cash. Fortunately, I keep my cards in a different place.
lines.ko: 현금 조금이요. 다행히 카드는 다른 곳에 넣어 둬요.
alt: Only some cash. Luckily, my cards were somewhere else.

lines.en: All right. I'll fill out a police report. You'll need a copy for your embassy.
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 경찰 신고서를 작성할게요. 대사관에 사본이 필요하실 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. Do you know where the Korean embassy is and whether I need an appointment?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 한국 대사관이 어디 있는지, 예약이 필요한지 아세요?
alt: Thanks. Where is the Korean embassy, and do I need an appointment?

lines.en: It's downtown, about twenty minutes by taxi. I'd call them first. They can issue an emergency travel document.
lines.ko: 시내에 있고 택시로 20분쯤이에요. 먼저 전화해 보세요. 긴급 여행 증명서를 발급해 줄 수 있어요.

lines.en: That's really helpful. Would you mind writing down the report number for me?
lines.ko: 정말 도움이 돼요. 신고 번호를 적어 주시겠어요?
alt: That helps a lot. Could you write down the report number for me?

lines.en: Not at all. Here it is. Keep this with you until you get home.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 여기 있습니다. 집에 갈 때까지 가지고 계세요.

expressions.note: 대답 «Not at all» = 기꺼이요 (싫지 않다는 뜻)
